office_does: The assessor values all taxable real and personal property in Chelan County and runs the property tax exemption programs. The assessor does not set tax rates.
race_blurb: Appointed in 2023 and elected that November, Assessor Wes Cornelius faces real estate broker Britini Port, who led the primary 53% to 47%. Port says high-value properties are under-assessed and modest homes over-assessed. Cornelius's campaign disputes her data and points to his 19 years in the office and his work on exemptions for seniors, disabled residents and veterans.

candidates.summary: Real estate broker and first-time candidate, running on a claim that luxury, second-home and corporate properties are under-assessed while modest homes are over-assessed.
highlights: Says high-value properties are assessed below market while working-class homes are assessed at or above it [S1]
Says she is not seeking higher taxes but 'accurate' ones [S5]
Pledges published methodology, tiered sale-to-assessment ratio reports and per-parcel valuation worksheets [S7]
Would promote senior, disabled-veteran and fixed-income exemptions and deferrals [S1][S7]

experience.basis: First-time candidate from private real estate, running on a critique of the office's methods against a 19-year insider.

taxes.basis: Would move the existing tax burden toward luxury, second-home and corporate-owned properties, while saying she does not seek higher overall taxes.

candidates.summary: Assessor since 2023 and in the office since 2007, running on experience, property tax relief for seniors, disabled residents and veterans, and modernized operations.
highlights: Joined the Assessor's Office in 2007; chief deputy 2012-2023; appointed assessor in 2023 and elected that November [S5][S7]
Says he is 'not interested in taxing people out of their homes' and lobbied for a higher senior exemption income limit [S6]
Says he worked with legislators on ESSB 6162 and HB 2375 expanding exemption programs [S7][S8]
Says Port's examples misread state mass-appraisal law and the office's software [S9]

experience.basis: Incumbent with about 19 years in the office, including more than a decade as chief deputy; argues that experience is the deciding qualification.

taxes.basis: Pushes property tax relief and expanded exemptions for seniors, disabled residents and veterans, and says he is not interested in taxing people out of their homes.
